time.knowledgeCutoff: inclusive canonical UTC instant, separately bound
time.businessDate: explicit YYYY-MM-DD Europe/Berlin business date, supplied independently of instant
time.overdue: dueDate strictly before businessDate; same-day due is not overdue
time.normalization: explicit offsets required; normalize all instants to UTC millisecond ISO before persistence; never order raw offset text
time.backdatedCorrections: apply only when BOTH validAt <= validCutoff and knownAt <= knowledgeCutoff; restatement is a new plan/result revision
time.cohort: invoiceDate retained separately, never used to select an invoice-month cohort

balance.formula: invoice principal minus independently aggregated eligible payments minus independently aggregated credits; cancellation clears principal
balance.creditOrOverpaymentBalance: negative residual is NOT a receivable; separately counted and quantified, never silently added to overdue stock
balance.fanout: aggregate payment and adjustment events per tenant/invoice BEFORE their separate 1:n joins
balance.integerAmounts: nonnegative safe integer source minor units -> canonical decimal strings -> PostgreSQL bigint/numeric integer sums -> decimal-string result; no floating-point sums

unknown.missingHistory: entire metric UNKNOWN, no totals/counts/drilldown/rate claimed
unknown.missingDueDate: positive residual cannot be classified overdue; affected invoice UNKNOWN
unknown.partialResult: full overdue amount/count/rate are null; separately labelled known subset retains actually observed scoped values
unknown.nullDenominator: no known open due-classifiable receivable -> ratio null/ZERO_DENOMINATOR; never zero percent

scope.rights: fixed OWN SYNTHETIC fixture scopes only; no real source/publisher/client-supplied hash authorization
scope.drilldown: known overdue invoices only; stable invoice/site sort, limit integer 1..20; true authorized total and truncation carried; no foreign counts/sums

bindings.source: exact shipped source bytes pinned by owner code; caller sourcebytes/digest options refused
bindings.snapshot: canonical pre-persist normalized documents actually reread from database, including keys and metadata; private immutable digest rechecked in one READ ONLY repeatable-read transaction
bindings.plan: opaque live owner-issued plan bound to snapshot+query template+metric bytes+cutoffs+scope+limit; cloned or rehashed client plan refused
bindings.result: immutable actual SQL summary+drilldown under plan; live owner-issued receipt and result revision, not freely rehashable authority
bindings.retirement: disposed owner invalidates pending execution and live adapter creation
bindings.consumer: versioned result adapter is an early part-contract; portable JSON alone carries no native authorization; no voice/table/chart/browser integration claimed
